notes: «أخبرنا سيار، وحصين، ومغيرة ... كلهم عن الشعبي»: seven co-transmitters meet at Sha'bi, written as alternatives in one level
«قال دخلت على فاطمة بنت قيس» is Sha'bi's own transmission; Fatima's words («فقالت طلقها زوجها») make her the last link (rule 6)
The Prophet is the one referred to in her words, not a link
